entities.name: Query HSL-like protein
observations: 720 aa; calculated molecular mass approximately 80.6 kDa and pI approximately 6.29.
Strong similarity to reviewed mammalian hormone-sensitive lipases: 33.2–34.1% identity, 96.5–99.4% query coverage, E-values 2.5e-112 to 5.5e-116.
Pfam supports an N-terminal HSL_N region at residues 1–303 and C-terminal alpha/beta hydrolase/esterase-related regions, including Abhydrolase_3 hits.
Best-supported functional class is an HSL-family serine hydrolase/lipase; exact substrate spectrum is inferred from homologs, not directly demonstrated for this sequence.

entities.name: Hormone-sensitive lipase
observations: Reviewed homologs are broad-specificity esterases/lipases that hydrolyze triacylglycerols, diacylglycerols, monoacylglycerols, cholesteryl esters, and retinyl esters.
Representative EC annotations include EC 3.1.1.23 and EC 3.1.1.79.
Homolog annotations identify catalytic serine-hydrolase chemistry and an oxyanion-hole motif, but the exact residue numbering is not directly mapped onto the query sequence.

entities.name: HSL ester hydrolysis
observations: Core reaction: an ester substrate plus H2O yields the corresponding alcohol-containing product plus a fatty acid and H+.

Representative reactions include diacylglycerol + H2O -> monoacylglycerol + fatty acid + H+, triacylglycerol + H2O -> diacylglycerol + fatty acid + H+, and monoacylglycerol + H2O -> glycerol + fatty acid + H+.
